  reference site, plus curated Detailed Member Reference subsections

  reference resolved against the verified product-page target
- Preserve all prior verified content; every capability claim checked
  against the current published source

repo.description: Aspose.3D FOSS for .NET is a MIT-licensed, pure-C# library for working with 3D file formats. Add a single NuGet package and immediately start reading, constructing, and writing 3D scenes without installing any native runtime, external SDK, or third-party renderer.
